description: A020301 - Ponte/viadotto/cavalcavia (Comune di Milano - DBT 2012 - DATASET) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Strato informativo del DataBase Topografico - DBT 2012 del Comune di Milano, volo marzo 2012, scala nominale di restituzione 1:1000. Opere per il collegamento della mobilità. La CLASSE A020301 appartiene al TEMA 0203 (Opere delle infrastrutture di trasporto) che compone lo STRATO 02 (Immobili ed antropizzazioni). Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are autostrada, cavalcavia, copertura-del-suolo, database, dbgt. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
